description: The DOMO Slate SL40 OS10 2C stands out from the crowd by delivering premium CPU performance and impressive features at a budget-friendly price. Whether you're a gamer, student, or professional, this tablet is designed to handle your needs with ease. Equipped with a bright 10.1-inch IPS HD display, the SL40 OS10 2C offers immersive visuals with a resolution of 1280x800 pixels. Supporting 4G voice calling and a wide array of connectivity options, it ensures you stay connected anytime, anywhere. Powered by a robust MTK 6750 Octa-Core Processor running at 2.5GHz and a Mali T860 GPU, the Slate SL40 OS10 2C offers smooth multitasking and high-performance gaming. The tablet comes with dual SIM card slots supporting 4G VoLTE networks, making it compatible with all major Indian telecom providers. With dual-band Wi-Fi, 4GB RAM, 32GB storage (expandable up to 512GB), and a premium metal body, it’s built for durability and versatility. Like all DOMO Slate Series products, the SL40 OS10 2C is proudly Made in India and backed by dedicated customer support.
